title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-04-05

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a marathon Dark Star → St. Stephen → Love Light stretch with stellar Pig Pen, offering a hidden gem for Deadheads.
ai_review.review: The recording showcases an impressive 17‑minute Dark Star that flows into St. Stephen and another epic 17‑minute Love Light, highlighted by what many consider some of the best Pig Pen playing ever captured. While no specific technical issues are noted, the soundboard source delivers a clear enough mix to let the extended jams shine.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review praises the musical performance heavily and mentions no recording problems; thus a strong show score with assumed decent soundboard quality yields a high rating, but confidence is low due to limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints about clarity or mix; presumed clean soundboard capture suitable for long jam listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Extended, seamless jams dominate the set, creating a hypnotic flow that highlights the band’s improvisational peak.

band_member_comments.Keys: Praised as delivering some of the best Pig Pen performances heard.
